title: The EU Commission unveils its tech sovereignty package, including the EU's Cloud and AI Development Act, in a bid to reduce its reliance on US tech companies (Mathieu Pollet/Politico)
summary: Mathieu Pollet / Politico: The EU Commission unveils its tech sovereignty package, including the EU's Cloud and AI Development Act, in a bid to reduce its reliance on US tech companies — The European Commission's so-called tech sovereignty plan aims to boost domestic champions rather than shut out American competitors.
